message: Add some details to the ignore field example

pr.title: Give a hint on the ignore field tag
pr.body:
Hello, 

I was having some troubles making kong *ignore a field*. Maybe giving the direct example in the `Supported Tag` table could help people out

diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 2d633f3..d8c553e 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -451,7 +451,7 @@ Tag                    | Description
 `set:"K=V"`            | Set a variable for expansion by child elements. Multiples can occur.
 `embed`                | If present, this field's children will be embedded in the parent. Useful for composition.
 `passthrough`          | If present, this positional argument stops flag parsing when encountered, as if `--` was processed before. Useful for external command wrappers, like `exec`.
-`-`                    | Ignore the field. Useful for adding non-CLI fields to a configuration struct.
+`-`                    | Ignore the field. Useful for adding non-CLI fields to a configuration struct. e.g `` `kong:"-"` ``
 
 ## Plugins

explanation.what: README のタグ一覧表にある `-`(フィールド無視)タグの説明に、実際のタグ記法の例 `` `kong:"-"` `` を追記した。コード側の変更はない。
explanation.why: PR本文に、`-` タグでフィールドを無視する使い方が分かりづらかったため、具体例を示すよう改善したいという趣旨が書かれている。
